scope_note: This is the Beck Institute's account of behavioral experiments; it is not interchangeable with every form of exposure.
statement: In the Beck model, therapists may help patients design between-session behavioral experiments to test cognitions framed as predictions.
statement_zh: 在 Beck 模型中，治療師可協助當事人設計會談間的行為實驗，以檢驗預測形式的認知。
